name: Disorder of Fatty Acid Oxidation and Ketogenesis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Biochemical and Genetic Diagnostic Criteria for Fatty Acid Oxidation Disorders

criteria.description: Presence of hypoketotic hypoglycemia during metabolic crisis
Abnormal acylcarnitine profile detected by tandem mass spectrometry
Reduced activity of specific fatty acid oxidation enzymes in fibroblasts or leukocytes
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes involved in fatty acid oxidation or ketogenesis
Episodes of metabolic decompensation triggered by fasting or illness

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of hypoketotic hypoglycemia, abnormal acylcarnitine profile, and identification of pathogenic genetic variants
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is confirmed by biochemical testing combined with molecular genetic analysis.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Elevated plasma acylcarnitines specific to fatty acid oxidation defects
searchTerms: specific blood markers for fat oxidation defects

pathognomonic.symptomName: Metabolic crisis precipitated by fasting or illness
searchTerms: metabolic crisis triggered by illness or fasting

common.notes: Often observed during or after metabolic crises
Enlarged liver due to fat accumulation

searchTerms: nausea and vomiting during metabolic breakdown

occasional.notes: Muscle breakdown during prolonged fasting or exercise

searchTerms: low blood pressure in metabolic crisis
drop in blood pressure during crisis

laboratory: Elevated plasma acylcarnitine species specific to fatty acid oxidation defects
Increased serum transaminases and creatine kinase during episodes
imaging: Liver ultrasound indicating hepatomegaly and steatosis
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes such as ACADM, HADHA, CPT2, HMGCS2
Molecular confirmation via targeted gene panels or whole exome sequencing
other: Enzyme activity assays demonstrating deficient fatty acid oxidation
Abnormal urine organic acid profile during metabolic crisis

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of hyperketonemia instead of hypoketotic hypoglycemia
Characteristic glycogen accumulation in liver biopsy
Different genetic mutations in G6PC gene
Broader mitochondrial dysfunction with multi-system involvement
Distinct genetic mutations affecting mitochondrial respiratory chain

redFlags: Severe hypoketotic hypoglycemia unresponsive to glucose supplementation
Recurrent metabolic crises triggered by fasting or illness
Progressive cardiomyopathy with heart failure symptoms
references: Roe CR, et al. Fatty acid oxidation disorders: diagnosis and management. J Inherit Metab Dis. 2020.
Orphanet Report Series: Disorders of fatty acid oxidation and ketogenesis. Orphanet. 2023.
Hsu BY, et al. Clinical and molecular features of fatty acid oxidation disorders. Mol Genet Metab. 2022.
